title: Great Kashmir Explorer
shortDescription: Eight days to see the whole valley properly — Srinagar, Sonmarg, Gulmarg and Pahalgam with overnight stays in each, so you're never rushing back.
description: For travellers who want to go deeper, the Great Kashmir Explorer spends a night in each of the valley's four great destinations. Staying over in Sonmarg means you see the Thajiwas Glacier in the quiet of early morning, long before the day-trippers arrive.

The pace is relaxed, the stays are comfortable, and there's room for detours — the saffron fields of Pampore, the walnut-wood carvers of Srinagar's old city, and the 9th-century temples at Avantipora.

highlights: Overnight in Sonmarg for a quiet glacier morning
Two nights each in Gulmarg and Pahalgam
Old city walk: Jamia Masjid, Shah-e-Hamdan and the spice markets
Saffron fields of Pampore and Avantipora ruins
Shikara ride and floating market on Dal Lake

itinerary.title: Arrive in Srinagar
itinerary.description: Airport pick-up and transfer to your hotel. In the evening, a shikara ride on Dal Lake past the floating gardens.

itinerary.title: Old city & Mughal gardens
itinerary.description: A guided walk through Srinagar's old city — the wooden Shah-e-Hamdan shrine, Jamia Masjid's 370 cedar pillars and the spice bazaars — followed by an afternoon in the Mughal gardens.

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Sonmarg
itinerary.description: Follow the Sindh river up to Sonmarg. Spend the afternoon walking in the meadows ringed by glaciers and fir forests.

itinerary.title: Thajiwas Glacier, then Gulmarg
itinerary.description: An early pony ride or walk to the Thajiwas Glacier before the crowds, then drive to Gulmarg via Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg Gondola
itinerary.description: Ride both phases of the Gulmarg Gondola to Apharwat Peak (weather permitting). Free afternoon for walks, golf or snow activities in season.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg to Pahalgam
itinerary.description: Drive to Pahalgam via the saffron fields of Pampore and the Avantipora temple ruins.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam valleys
itinerary.description: Explore Betaab, Aru and Chandanwari valleys, with time for a riverside lunch and a walk in the pine forests.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Transfer to Srinagar airport for your flight home.

inclusions: 7 nights in superior hotels on twin sharing
Private sedan for all transfers and sightseeing
exclusions: Gondola tickets, pony rides and local union cabs
knowBeforeYouGo: Sonmarg is usually accessible from April to November
Carry a government photo ID at all times

seo.title: Great Kashmir Explorer — 7N/8D Kashmir Tour
seo.description: 8-day Kashmir tour with overnight stays in Srinagar, Sonmarg, Gulmarg and Pahalgam. From ₹42,500 per person, expertly planned.
